original_current_reads: observe_original uses the unchanged evaluated remote owner path with actual live C and original T/E reads before and after
fresh_and_incomplete: No local Execute request is sent. Original missing/pending/invalid/withdrawn readback errors propagate.
cancellation: The blocking read may continue after outer future cancellation. Permit and actual operation remain owned by that work until terminal; the cancelled caller has unknown delivery. It does not imply cancellation of an individual original T/E exchange.
wire: same underlying complete receipt authenticator as client decode_completed and existing original evidence endpoint; no externally supplied snapshot/signature
